# fastf 3.7.0 — long notes wrap in the pane

A note longer than the detail pane is wide was cut off with `…`, so the end of
it could only be read in the notes view or in the file. The pane wraps it now.
Everything else in this release is about the record rather than the tool: the
documentation is reorganised, and the code behind the app is tidied.

## Notes and todos wrap

A line of a note that does not fit the pane continues on the rows under it, the
way the notes view (`J`) shows it, and a long todo does the same. A note still
shows its first eight rows in the pane and says how many more there are; the
notes view has all of it. Resize the window and the text wraps to the new width.

## Six guides, one subject each

The documentation is six guides:
[the app](https://github.com/cristocola/fast-folder/blob/main/docs/app.md),
[the commands](https://github.com/cristocola/fast-folder/blob/main/docs/cli.md),
[settings and where your data lives](https://github.com/cristocola/fast-folder/blob/main/docs/config.md),
[templates](https://github.com/cristocola/fast-folder/blob/main/docs/templates.md),
[the project model](https://github.com/cristocola/fast-folder/blob/main/docs/projects.md)
and [Windows](https://github.com/cristocola/fast-folder/blob/main/docs/windows.md).
The app's keys and what it remembers between runs are described as they are,
and `fastf config set --help` lists `motion` with the other keys.

No flag, config key or file format changed: every `config.toml`, template and
`PROJECT_INFO.md` works exactly as before.
